estimator.name: utf8-byte4-v1
estimator.definition: ceil(UTF-8 bytes / 4) per unique repository source, summed after de-duplication
estimator.material_saving_rule: pre_estimate - post_estimate must exceed pre_uncertainty + post_uncertainty

process_envelope.scope: Four-layer budget. Base profile budgets cover repository-owned initial_reads. Conditional-profile budgets cover the checker-owned superset of every fixed repository source named or required by canonical conditional_reads for that profile. Route-effective budgets cover concrete H1/CITY/PA mandatory capsule/non-compressible/escalation sets. Dynamic-repository budgets apply to every resolved repository-backed mandatory slot for any concrete route, including future WPs, exact dependency/evidence sources and manifest-named repository files. Genuinely external live GitHub/API/diff payloads remain outside repository corpus budgets but must be explicitly classified external.

worker.rationale: Exact CTX-03 base-profile calibration; fixed conditional and dynamic repository sources are budgeted separately below.

repair_worker.rationale: Repository-owned base initial reads calibrate to 19028; exact FAIL/PR payloads may be external, while any repository-backed exact evidence is covered by the dynamic repository envelope.

reviewer.rationale: Repository-owned base initial reads calibrate to 19028; candidate diff/live PR are external while repository predecessor/evidence sources are covered by the dynamic repository envelope.

planner_gate.rationale: Planner base calibrates to 19955 after accepted-closure history moved out of current ROADMAP.

docsync.rationale: Repository-owned DocSync starting sources calibrate to 8594; accepted PR/review/merge payload is external, while exact accepted repository sources are dynamically budgeted.

h1_local_executor.rationale: The narrow local-executor base corpus calibrates to 6311; anchored manifest and manifest-named repository files are covered by the dynamic repository envelope.

worker.rationale: Base Worker pack plus checker-owned fixed conditional superset: foundational proof, H1 remote/local protocol, ROADMAP, capsule protocol and capsule index.

repair_worker.rationale: Base repair pack plus the fixed conditional sources that can become mandatory while repairing H1/cross-track/capsule-backed work.

reviewer.rationale: Base Reviewer pack plus the fixed conditional sources that can become mandatory for foundational, H1-local, cross-track or capsule-backed review.

planner_gate.rationale: Planner base already contains ROADMAP; fixed conditional superset additionally contains FOUNDATIONAL_PROOF_STANDARD.md.

docsync.rationale: DocSync base plus fixed conditional ROADMAP and accepted-PA capsule protocol/index sources.

h1_local_executor.rationale: Local executor declares no fixed conditional_reads; its conditional-profile set therefore equals its base pack.

dynamic_repository_envelope.rationale: Fail-closed ceiling for repository-backed mandatory sources whose concrete identity is route/WP dependent. Every resolved source is bounded individually and the de-duplicated dynamic set is bounded in aggregate. New placeholder classes require checker-owned classification; future ceiling increases require explicit policy revision and justification. These conservative initial limits prevent unlimited growth without pretending to be a calibration of one current representative route.

minimum.rationale: Worker H1 route including foundational + H1-local mandatory conditionals and accepted predecessor capsule navigation.

escalated.rationale: Same H1 route after authoritative predecessor escalation.

minimum.rationale: Reviewer H1 route including foundational + H1-local mandatory conditionals and accepted predecessor capsule navigation.

escalated.rationale: Same H1 route after authoritative predecessor escalation.

minimum.rationale: Worker CITY route including cross-track ROADMAP and non-compressible CITY predecessor material.

escalated.rationale: Same CITY route after authoritative predecessor escalation.

minimum.rationale: Reviewer CITY route including cross-track ROADMAP and non-compressible CITY predecessor material.

escalated.rationale: Same CITY route after authoritative predecessor escalation.

minimum.rationale: Cumulative PA Worker route with all accepted PA capsules and mandatory reads.

escalated.rationale: Cumulative PA Worker route after material escalation to authoritative accepted PA results.

minimum.rationale: Cumulative PA Reviewer route with all accepted PA capsules and mandatory reads.

escalated.rationale: Cumulative PA Reviewer route after material escalation to authoritative accepted PA results.

same_snapshot_measurement.snapshot_contract: All pre/post file bytes are read from the same checked-out candidate snapshot. Pre-CTX routing is reconstructed from checker-owned canonical representative direct-predecessor sources, not from the compact artifacts being measured. Post-CTX routing is the accepted canonical role profile plus validated capsule navigation and checker-owned route-forced mandatory conditionals. Fixed conditional profile coverage is independently bounded even when a fixed conditional is not activated by one of the six representative measurement routes. Dynamic repository-backed mandatory inputs are separately bounded for every resolved concrete route; genuinely external live GitHub/API/diff payloads remain mandatory but outside repository corpus budgets.
